cndp: Processing declared to the CNDP under law 09-08.
intro: This document describes what Salifz stores and what it does not. It matches the actual behaviour of the code, not an intention.
notStoredLocation: No location: qibla and prayer times are computed on your device.
notStoredSession: No session duration: nothing in the app measures time spent.
notStoredTracking: No advertising trackers, no data sharing for commercial purposes.
rightCorrect: Correct your profile information at any time.
rightDelete: Delete your account, which erases your progress data and recitations.
rightExport: Export all your data from settings, in a readable format.
sourcesBody: The Quran text and translations come from quran.com. Audio recitations are served by islamic.network.
storedAccount: Your email, username and, if you provide one, your display name.
storedProgress: Your progress: memorized verses, reviews, streaks, XP and gems.
storedRecitations: The recitations you send to a teacher, until you delete them.
title: Privacy
